sentence: The room's organizing restates in the model's terms - host-sub line-drawing and removals (P20), calls for wholesome marks (P01-P03), keeping/moving LOVE (P05/P10), truces and coalitions (P08/P17/P18), and post-close recording (P12) - and the unused concepts are April Fools play, dog/family jokes, timer explanations, defense/truce reports, and after-close records, none showing organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

The room's canvas organising restates in the model's terms — its call for LOVE defenders and alt accounts, its truce with a neighbouring clan, its removals of canvas posts under ordinary rules, and its post-close recording — but the unplaced dog-drawing and family-April-Fools themes (t11, t14; c0053–c0070) carry a sub's jest-and-lore life that no element covers.
